title: Quiz Nanairo Dreams: Nijiiro-chou no Kiseki
native_title: ＱＵＩＺ なないろ ＤＲＥＡＭＳ ～虹色町の奇跡～
overview:
Huge response! Praise sent to Nijiiro Town

- I tricked a friend into playing it, and that friend got completely hooked. (19, student)
- My girlfriend keeps telling me to hurry up and show her the rest of the story, but I like the quiz part. (16, high school student)
- I'm not very good at quizzes, but I thought "Nijiiro Town might be OK" and tried it. Then somehow I got smarter. (20, university student)
- What, you make friends with girls for the sake of peace? Well, isn't that nice - isn't that fun! (28, office worker)

Quiz Nanairo Dreams is a romance adventure quiz from Capcom. One night, falling stars rain down on Nijiiro Town, and one of them turns out to be a tiny fairy. The crystal that keeps a demon king sealed away has shattered, and its seven pieces now rest within seven women of the town. The only way to recover them is to win each woman's heart before the demon king returns.

Spin the roulette to move across a calendar-shaped board, choose your route at each fork, and land on a heroine's space to pick a quiz genre and answer questions to raise her affection. Get close enough and her story moves forward. Miss too many and you lose your life cards, which can also be played for effects such as revealing answers. Each month ends with a quiz showdown against the rival Rinz.

- Seven stories ranging from science fiction and magic to pure romance
- Around 6,000 quiz questions
- Voiced heroines with lip-synced dialogue
- Original stories added for the fairy and Rinz
- 1 or 2 players

大反響！虹色町によせられた称賛の声

- 友人をだましてやらしてみたらその友人ハマっちゃいましたよ、見事に。（19才　学生）
- 彼女は早くストーリーの続きを見せろって言うけど、僕はこのクイズ部分が好きだな。（16才　高校生）
- 私ってクイズはちょっと苦手、でも「虹色町なら」ってやってみたの。そしたらなんだか頭よくなってたの。（20才　女子大生）
- なんだよ、平和の為に女の子と仲良くするのかよ。いいじゃねーか、面白いじゃねーかよ。（28才　会社員）
